subject: Improving the response time of "Stop Instance" & "Save Settings"

messages.author: 421e7cda090d43ed
messages.subject: Improving the response time of "Stop Instance" & "Save Settings"
parts:
I've just uploaded my first app onto shinyapps.io and after the upload, I noticed that it takes a while (~ 0.3 active hours) for the app instance to stop long after the "Stop" button is clicked. Please can anyone provide an explanation for why this is happening and how to improve it? 

Also, I currently can't save any changes made to my Settings as the "Save Settings" button is not responding. Any help would be much appreciated.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Improving the response time of "Stop Instance" & "Save Settings"
parts:
Amara,

When you say "Stop", do you mean from the Dashboard -> Application's Overview page? That should stop the instance immediately. If you are not seeing that, we need to figure out why.

If "Save Settings" button is disabled, there could be that a setting on the page is not valid; please check the settings. If it became unresponsive after you clicked it, then please check the browser console for any errors.

Fereshteh
